notes:
Discovery notes, quick bullets and quotes from AE/SE/Customer.
- Business: curated home goods marketplace, heavy seasonality (Nov 10 - Dec 5 peak + flash sales).
- Current search: lexicographic + boosting rules; relevance suffers for long-tail queries and seasonal promos.
- Scale: catalog ~3.2M SKUs, active catalog ~1.1M (seasonal catalogs grow to ~4.5M during peak). Need scalable indexing and incremental updates.
- Priority: embeddings + approximate nearest neighbors for recall, and a cheap high-precision reranker for top-k. Customer: "We need top-5 to feel relevant for promotions or we lose conversions."
- Latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 150ms for embeddings nearest-neighbor stage; end-to-end (embed + rerank) p95 target < 350ms.
- Cost target: blended cost per query <$0.035 at 95th percentile during normal traffic, and <$0.07 during peak bursts (with dedicated capacity options).
- Routing/fallback: prefer local (regional) inference for EU traffic, fallback to cheaper model variant if Dedicated busy.
- Security: SSO + SAML required, audit logs for marketing promos, retention controls for PII in product descriptions. KMS integration required for Dedicated/private.
- Quote from Head of Engineering: "We will run Black Friday style synthetic load against your POC to validate both cost and latency — if it holds, this is an enterprise deal."
- Docs referenced: pricing deck + security FAQ shared (drive links above).
- SE notes: consider hybrid design: approximate ANN (vector index) + lightweight cross-encoder filter for rerank for top-20. Evaluate Redwood Optimize suggestions for caching frequent queries and prefix-KV caching.
- Open items: clarify exact model family (open vs vendor) for reranker, need guidance on quantized cross-encoder options and Dedicated reserved capacity pricing for 2-week peak windows.
- Meeting cadence: weekly touch with SE during POC, AE check-in every 2 weeks.
